title: Mongolia’s President at the SCO Summit
author: Bolor Lkhaajav
text:
Mongolia’s President Khurelsukh Ukhnaa stands alongside other SCO heads of state in preparation for a group photo during the 2026 Bishkek Summit, Sep. 1, 2026.
Credit: Government of Mongolia
Mongolian President Khurelsukh Ukhnaa is attending the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Council of Heads of State in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan as the organization recognizes its 25th anniversary. While the SCO spent much of its existence focused on security and regional cooperation, the Bishkek Declaration demonstrates a much larger global agenda. Mongolia, in the new partner state status, is seeking deeper ties with SCO member states in emerging sectors via robust bilateral links.For example, Khurelsukh and Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, the summit’s host, held bilateral talks to accelerate political, economic, and trade relations under the Comprehensive Partnership Agreement that was signed during Khurelsukh’s state visit to Bishkek in 2025.  [...]
